description: Keep the lago-packages bases pinned by digest and up to date. Extend it from any repository that builds on ghcr.io/getlago/*-base or *-build images. Dockerfiles reference them as `ARG RUNTIME_IMAGE=ghcr.io/getlago/<base>:latest@sha256:<digest>`: Renovate opens one PR per repository when `latest` moves.

packageRules.description: lago-packages bases: pin the digest, track `latest`, one grouped PR, no release-age wait (base updates carry CVE fixes).
